procedureDetail.sidebarSubtitle: Schedule a private, no-obligation consultation with our surgical team.
procedureDetail.faqA1: The best way to determine candidacy is a private consultation with one of our surgeons. Generally, good candidates are in overall good health, have realistic expectations, and are non-smokers.
procedureDetail.faqA2: Depending on the procedure, we use either general anesthesia or local anesthesia with IV sedation. Your surgeon will discuss the safest and most comfortable option for you.
procedureDetail.faqA3: Some improvement is visible immediately, though full results develop as swelling subsides — typically within a few weeks to months. Your surgeon will give you a personalized timeline.
procedureDetail.faqA4: Yes. We partner with several financing companies to offer flexible payment plans. Contact our office to learn about available options.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Trusted cosmetic surgeons in Miami with over 20 years of experience. We are dedicated to helping patients across South Florida achieve natural, stunning results.
aboutPage.storyP1: Your Cosmetic Surgery & SPA is a state-of-the-art clinic led by a surgeon with over 20 years of experience. We have become a trusted name in cosmetic surgery across South Florida, serving patients from Miami, Hialeah, and from all over the country.
aboutPage.storyP2: With flexible financing options, we make a wide variety of popular procedures accessible for everyone. Our team's philosophy is simple: we don't change who you are — we reveal the best version of you. Every treatment plan is crafted individually, never templated.
aboutPage.storyP3: Led by Dr. Mario Reyes-Serrano, our surgical team brings decades of combined expertise to every procedure — from BBL and Lipo 360 to rhinoplasty, facelifts, and everything in between.
aboutPage.safetyDesc: Every procedure is performed in our AAAHC-accredited surgical suite in Hialeah, with the highest standards of patient safety.
aboutPage.artDesc: We blend surgical expertise with an artist's eye — every result is designed to look natural and enhance your unique beauty.
aboutPage.expDesc: Our surgical team brings decades of combined experience across every facet of cosmetic and aesthetic medicine.
aboutPage.careDesc: From your first call to your final follow-up, you are treated with discretion, compassion, and genuine care.
aboutPage.drBio1: Dr. Reyes-Serrano is a cosmetic surgeon with more than 20 years of experience. He has been a licensed physician in Florida since 2005. His expertise spans body contouring, breast surgery, and facial procedures, with a reputation for results that look completely natural.
aboutPage.drBio2: Patients travel from across the country — and internationally — to be treated by Dr. Reyes-Serrano and the Your Cosmetic Surgery & SPA team in Hialeah, FL.
aboutPage.milestone2004: Your Cosmetic Surgery & SPA founded with a commitment to natural, patient-first results in South Florida.
aboutPage.milestone2008: Achieved AAAHC accreditation for our state-of-the-art surgical facility in Hialeah.
aboutPage.milestone2012: Surpassed 1,000 successful procedures with a 98% patient satisfaction rate.
aboutPage.milestone2016: Expanded services to include cutting-edge MedSpa treatments alongside surgical procedures.
aboutPage.milestone2020: Recognized among the Top Cosmetic Surgery Centers in South Florida.
aboutPage.milestone2024: Over 5,000 transformations and counting — each one a unique story of renewed confidence.
